function check(plr)
    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.sub(v.Name:lower(), 1, #plr) == plr:lower() or string.sub(v.DisplayName:lower(), 1, #plr) == plr:lower() then
            return v.Name, v
        end
    end
    return nil
end
